paragraphs.text: Repaint the reception door leaves, retaining the existing locks and handles. Staff will provide access on Saturday.
The handles can be removed for the coating work. The receptionist asked that the key labels remain with the locksets.
Include removing handles before coating, keeping them labelled, and reinstalling them afterward. List the reinstallation explicitly, since this is a complete return-to-service package.
Label and remove door handles. Prepare and coat both reception door leaves.
Protect locksets in place and clean up after coating. Saturday access by staff. Included work is limited to this schedule.
